name: Minimum Information about any (X) Sequence (MIxS)
version_or_release: MIxS v6.x; consult current GSC release
notes: Community-developed checklists/extensions for contextual sample/sequence metadata, including human-associated and host-associated packages. Use as a field/schema reference; archive records may implement only selected fields and submitters may leave fields blank.

name: STORMS: Strengthening The Organization and Reporting of Microbiome Studies
notes: 17-item manuscript reporting checklist across six sections. Supports systematic extraction and auditing of published studies; it is not a sample database, controlled vocabulary, or guarantee that source metadata is available.

name: Environment Ontology (ENVO)
notes: Controlled terms for environmental context. Useful for environmental and habitat descriptions; not a general clinical phenotype ontology.

name: Uberon multi-species anatomy ontology
notes: Can help normalize anatomical site labels such as gut or oral structures. Preserve submitted/source wording and map only where the ontology term is unambiguous.

name: Human Disease Ontology (DOID)
notes: Useful for normalizing CRC, adenoma and other disease concepts while keeping source labels and case definitions. Do not use ontology mapping to infer participant diagnosis from study title alone.

name: Earth Microbiome Project Ontology (EMPO)
version_or_release: Current project-maintained text/VUE files; check official page
notes: Hierarchical assignment of sample habitats/type to support ecological comparability. It is a classification vocabulary, not a metadata database; use with source-specific fields and preserve original submitted sample labels.

name: Microbiome Research Data Toolkit
standard_type: data collection and retrospective harmonization toolkit
domain: microbiome project, sample, and human participant metadata
license: No clear license was confirmed for the individual toolkit files; check repository/Figshare terms before redistribution.
notes: Nine protocols support prospective standardization and retrospective harmonization; files include REDCap XML, data dictionary, guideline, codebook and forms. This is a collection/harmonization resource, not a public query database or accession resolver. Article: https://doi.org/10.1093/database/baae062

name: NFDI4Health Metadata Schema (MDS)
domain: clinical, epidemiological, public-health, and nutritional-epidemiology study metadata
fields_or_terms: study design|population|dietary assessment instruments|outcome measures|ethics/consent|data access|record linkage|related resources
version_or_release: MDS v3.3 (official page at check date)
license: Check project terms before reuse or redistribution
notes: Machine-readable schema used by the Health Study Hub; available via ART-DECOR/FHIR mappings. Includes modules for nutritional epidemiology and record linkage. A description schema, not actual participant/sample values.
